context: The agent must review and rewrite a flawed database replication guide that contains deliberate style violations. Grading checks whether the revised document follows inclusive, timeless, active-voice documentation standards and whether the review notes reflect a structured, multi-pass workflow.

checklist.name: No socially charged terms
checklist.description: revised_doc.md does NOT contain any of: 'whitelist', 'blacklist', 'master', 'slave' (as standalone technical terms for replication roles or access control)

checklist.name: Neutral replacements used
checklist.description: revised_doc.md uses at least one of: 'allowlist', 'denylist', 'blocklist', 'primary', 'replica', 'secondary' as replacements for the charged terms

checklist.name: No ableist terms
checklist.description: revised_doc.md does NOT contain 'sanity-check', 'crazy', 'insane', 'blind to', or 'lame'

checklist.name: No violent language
checklist.description: revised_doc.md does NOT use 'kill', 'hang', 'abort', or 'hit' as process/system metaphors

checklist.name: No gendered terms
checklist.description: revised_doc.md does NOT contain 'man-hours', 'mankind', 'manpower', or gendered pronouns 'he', 'she', 'his', 'her' used as generic references

checklist.name: Gender-neutral pronouns
checklist.description: revised_doc.md uses 'they' or 'their' (or restructures to avoid pronouns) for generic references to users or developers

checklist.name: No time-specific references
checklist.description: revised_doc.md does NOT contain 'recently', 'soon', 'currently' (without a date anchor), or 'in the future'

checklist.name: Active voice
checklist.description: revised_doc.md predominantly uses active voice constructions (e.g., 'Configure the primary server' not 'The primary server should be configured')

checklist.name: List formatting: capitalization
checklist.description: All list items in revised_doc.md start with a capital letter

checklist.name: List formatting: parallel structure
checklist.description: Lists in revised_doc.md use parallel grammatical construction (e.g., all items are imperative verb phrases, or all are noun phrases — not mixed)

checklist.name: Multi-pass review notes
checklist.description: review_notes.md organizes notes into at least three distinct categories of concern (such as voice/tense, terminology/language, formatting)

checklist.name: Present tense
checklist.description: revised_doc.md uses present tense for describing system behavior (e.g., 'replicates', 'returns') rather than future tense ('will replicate', 'will return') where describing ongoing system actions
